description:
An order by its token. status goes pending (unpaid) → paid → provisioning →
        ready; also expired, underpaid, failed_provisioning, gift_waiting, and
        payment_held — the payment processor's compliance check stopped the payment and
        holds the money: nothing is issued, the person must not pay again and should
        write to support. When ready,
        esim.activation_code is the LPA string (render it as a QR code), with iccid,
        smdp and matching_id. After payment poll every ~10 s; delivery usually takes
        under a minute.
name: get_order
